# tomswallapi_device (Resource)

A fleet member. Its class (router/firewall) and fabric determine how it enforces intents; bindings map global zones to its local interfaces.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_device" "fw1" {
  name   = "fw1"
  class  = "firewall"
  fabric = "core"

  settings = {
    log_level = "info"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `class` (String) Device class: router or firewall.
- `name` (String) Device name (globally unique).

### Optional

- `fabric` (String) Routing domain (fabric) this device belongs to.
- `resolver` (List of String) Per-device DNS resolver override for dns address groups. Falls back to the fleet default, then system resolvers.
- `settings` (Map of String) Per-device settings overrides (e.g. table_name, log_level, address_family).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name.
terraform import tomswallapi_device.fw1 fw1
```
